title: Beautiful cozy apartment with parking on premises.
description:
This studio apartment is attached to the main house but has its own private entrance and is fully independent (not a separate house).

It includes a king-size bed, full bathroom, equipped kitchen, and free parking. The space is completely private — perfect to relax or work from home.

The studio also has access to a shared outdoor space. Located 17 minutes from Nashville International Airport, 14 minutes to downtown Nashville, between I-65 and I-24. Walmart is 5 minutes away.
